title: Ticket Status Inquiry
story: As a requestor, I want to ask about my existing tickets, so that I can receive updates without contacting the service desk.

acceptanceCriteria.when: the assistant retrieves my ticket information
acceptanceCriteria.then: I can view a list of my open tickets including ticket number and status

acceptanceCriteria.given: I ask about a specific ticket
acceptanceCriteria.when: I provide a ticket number or description
acceptanceCriteria.then: I can see the details for that specific ticket

acceptanceCriteria.given: I ask about another user's ticket
acceptanceCriteria.then: unauthorized ticket information is never disclosed
clear messaging is provided indicating no open tickets exist

edgeCases: User asks about a ticket that was merged
User provides incorrect ticket number format
Ticket was recently closed and not yet visible
User asks about tickets from a previous account/role
